beats.say: Club Brugge has been crowned Belgian league champions 20 times.
Records show the club was founded on 13 November 1891.
They hold the European record for the highest number of consecutive participations in the UEFA Europa League, with 20.
Daniel Amokachi became the first goal scorer in the Champions League on 25 November 1992.
That is quite the legacy for a team with 20 league titles.
